paper.title_en: The Generalized Second Law from Fluctuation Theorems in a Quantum Reference Frame
paper.abstract_en: We prove the generalized second law (GSL) for black-hole exteriors undergoing unitary driving and relaxation on a fixed semifinite algebra. Wall's influential proof [arXiv:1105.3445] assumes semiclassical geometry and restricts fixed parent states to algebras of successive horizon cuts. We instead evolve the state on a fixed dressed exterior algebra. With complete characteristic data, the same semiclassical exterior supports both descriptions, analogous to the Heisenberg and Schrödinger pictures through state-operator duality. The asymptotic horizon charge is the momentum of a quantum clock; its conjugate gives the reading. The modular crossed product admits density operators whose entropy with respect to its trace reproduces generalized entropy up to clock contributions. Our approach parallels thermodynamics in regulated field theory and formulates the GSL through a quantum channel fluctuation theorem (FT) for the open exterior. We develop three complementary formulations under specified dynamical assumptions. Separated unitary driving and relaxation combine modular work, the physical-process first law relating horizon absorption to area gain, and relative-entropy contraction through data processing. A time-local description accommodates simultaneous unitary driving and dissipation. A two-time measurement of surprisal, the negative logarithm of the density operator, gives an FT for the complete exterior channel. It identifies the correction for a nonunital channel and gives a GSL bound for unital evolution without resolving intermediate dynamics. Relaxation that preserves every dressed-charge sector and the full faithful dressed reference state is unital. Unitality is sufficient for this FT proof but is not necessary for the GSL along a particular evolution. The bounds establish the GSL in the slow-clock limit when the errors vanish and quantify what is needed at finite clock width.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在固定半有限代数与修饰外部代数框架下，利用量子通道涨落定理重新证明黑洞外部广义第二定律，涉及模交叉乘积、渐近视界荷与量子时钟、相对熵数据加工等深层理论工具，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强；同时触及广义相对论基础中的代数量子场论与量子参考系问题。虽为近期预印本且尚无引用（中性处理），仍值得关注。
decision.title_zh: 量子参考系中由涨落定理导出的广义第二定律
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明：对于在固定半有限代数上进行幺正驱动与弛豫的黑洞外部，广义第二定律（GSL）成立。Wall 具有影响力的证明 [arXiv:1105.3445] 假设半经典几何，并将固定的母态（parent states）限制在连续视界切片的代数上。我们则改为在固定的修饰外部代数上演化态。在具备完整特征数据时，同一半经典外部可同时支持这两种描述，这类似于通过态-算符对偶的海森堡图像与薛定谔图像。渐近视界荷是量子时钟的动量；其共轭量给出读数。模交叉乘积（modular crossed product）容许存在密度算符，其相对于该迹的熵在计及时钟贡献后重现广义熵。我们的方法类似于正规化场论中的热力学，并通过对开放外部构造量子通道涨落定理（FT）来表述 GSL。我们在指定的动力学假设下发展三种互补的表述。分离的幺正驱动与弛豫结合了模功、将视界吸收与面积增加联系起来的物理过程第一定律，以及通过数据处理实现的相对熵收缩。时间局域描述可容纳同时发生的幺正驱动与耗散。对惊奇度（即密度算符的负对数）进行两次时间测量，可得到完整外部通道的 FT。它识别出非幺正通道的修正，并给出幺正演化的 GSL 界，而无需解析中间动力学。保持每个修饰荷扇区以及完整忠实修饰参考态的弛豫是幺正的。幺正性对该 FT 证明是充分的，但对沿特定演化的 GSL 并非必要。这些界在慢时钟极限下、误差消失时确立了 GSL，并量化了在有限时钟宽度下所需的条件。
